auxiliary_scope_before_gate: resource enumeration and reuse of exactly matching measured PHY only; no auxiliary quality population or real-link sweep
frozen_visual_assets: Original M1 unconditional Encoder/VQ/VAR/F/Dc; actual asset SHA256 must match original M1 calibration registration

generation.method: deterministic greedy argmax at every scale; received tokens clamped
generation.per_image_state_random_seed: not applicable because there is no token sampling
generation.numeric: original deterministic FP32; TF32 and autocast disabled
generation.cache_acceleration: source-local teacher-forced prefix and KV reuse; require exact fresh-path token/latent/RGB parity before enabling

calibration.identity: original registered calibration source IDs and preprocessing, unchanged order
calibration.cost_pilot: at most first two calibration sources; engineering equivalence and timing only
calibration.full_search_default: all 1000 calibration sources for all feasible N1024 states
calibration.cost_fallback: if measured estimate for quality plus BLER and actual-link/report exceeds 48h, screen complete registered grid on fixed first300 calibration sources, freeze family top3 + strongest baselines + B3-matched pools + distinct validation candidates, then reevaluate their needed states on original full1000
calibration.fallback_disclosure: 1000-source optimum is only over the screened finite shortlist; no global-full-grid optimum claim
calibration.score_refinement: BLER uncertainty refinement uses only calibrated objective and preset families; independent validation scores never refine candidates

body.implementation: Sionna 2.2.0 LDPC5GEncoder and LDPC5GDecoder, isolated Python3.11/PyTorch2.11.0 environment
body.decoder: boxplus-phi flooding, 20 fixed iterations, clipped absolute LLR20, no early stop, float32
body.rate_matching: actual Sionna supported RV0 lengths, output interleaver by modulation width; no invented repetition support
body.scrambling: public deterministic independent encoded-bit mask from protocol/session/frame/group counter; counter known by both ends from experiment frame schedule, never payload, label, or true noise
body.unused_symbols: known QPSK filler, fully charged in N and energy, not source information

header.meaning: profile_id in final public frozen codebook
header.receiver_format_source: only actual header-decoded profile_id and public codebook

candidate_source.K: 0,floor(L/4),floor(L/2),floor(3L/4),maximum legal K per actual N,m,j,MCS tuple,allocation mode; normalize K=L to next whole
candidate_source.ordering: original entropy values, rounding and deterministic tie rule; no location side information
candidate_source.full_budget_fill: remaining symbols proportional to nominal symbol allocations, integer residual by group index, each actual new LDPC configuration revalidated
candidate_source.B0_strength: same source/MCS grid and legal full-budget fill as all new families

power.16QAM: fixed PAM levels [-3,-1,3,1]/sqrt(5), actual E recorded per frame
power.claim: same total complex uses and same average symbol power

receiver.group1_accept_group2_reject: complete from accepted group1 prefix only
receiver.all_groups_accept: complete from actual accepted full prefix and partial values
receiver.false_acceptance: count and render actual wrong accepted bits; Q-state model ignores these only as an explicitly checked approximation
receiver.direct: unknown partial positions use zero embedding; never token index0; absent scales add no contribution

BLER.actual_image_payload_validation: frozen finalists; source-dependent probability requires per-source/stratified Q-p combination
BLER.zero_observed_errors: retain interval; never call exact zero BLER

independent_metric.name: convnext_source_prediction_agreement
independent_metric.weights: IMAGENET1K_V1, convnext_tiny-983f1562.pth, full SHA recorded before run

development.DINO_L_role: calibration-selected optimization objective, not independent validation
development.holdout: not opened; reused development exploratory evidence
development.P1024_10dB: new inference with original selected40000 model and registered population/noise; no training
development.historical_new_protocol_baseline: old M1 hard-failure behavior is only labeled historical reference, never B0-B4 baseline
development.external_controls: only exactly matching measured populations/workpoints; unmeasured cells remain blank

extension_gate.rule: both paired95%CI lower bounds strictly above0 at at least2 actual SNRs; passed points must be nondegenerate G2 and actual probability/order model validation must pass
extension_gate.insufficient_evidence: report means and intervals, stop; never append development sources to seek significance
extension_gate.next_if_pass: N2048 4/7/13dB registered replication only; no other expansion

timing.TX_entropy: measure uncached frozen VAR entropy ordering separately, report relative to original approximately60-75ms historical measurement; raster only discussed, no new sort search
timing.receive: controlled online timing disables final-image caches
timing.parallel: leave existing N2048 job intact; benchmark CPU PHY and bounded separate GPU tasks before choosing concurrent scheduling; no hardware setting changes

stop: deliver all positive/negative N1024 results and registered extension decision, push reviewed results normally, stop; no training, M2, adapter, new channel or old queues
